title: Polynomial size for the all-ones language
statement: The language consisting of Boolean words whose entries are all true is recognized by a family of well-formed acyclic Boolean circuits with fan-in at most two, with size bounded by a polynomial in the input length.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the all-ones language or the polynomial bound's coefficients and degree.
